# [D7 — Storm-driven resuspension](../hypodrafts/D7.md "Storm-driven resuspension")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_d7.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Status.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-PANEL">`stations_series.json`, the monthly panel this project analyses, carries [9](../SOURCES.md#F-81bea72caf) variables — temperature, salinity, oxygen and oxygen saturation at surface and bed, and fluorescence — none of them turbidity, each a monthly median per station.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-PANEL "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-WAVESHARE">The wave model held here puts the modelled bed shear at [3](../SOURCES.md#F-8b8eb9b44c) m above the dead-bed threshold in [61](../SOURCES.md#F-807092ae2b)% of all hours, so a monthly median describes a mixture, not an event.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-WAVESHARE "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-MONTHLY">**The monthly product cannot test [D7](../hypodrafts/D7.md "Storm-driven resuspension").** The dated raw record can:</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-MONTHLY "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-TRANSP">it holds transparency series — Secchi depths, light-attenuation profiles and CTD turbidity. The first two feed this project's light analysis; none has been set against modelled bed shear.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-TRANSP "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The observable consequence, stated so it can fail

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-MECH">Under [D7](../hypodrafts/D7.md "Storm-driven resuspension"), resuspension is depth-limited — in the wave model held here the orbital velocity at the bed falls with depth through sinh *kh* — substrate-limited, since only mobile fine sediment suspends, and it *relaxes* as that sediment settles again. The predictions, per station-visit, net of station mean, month-of-year and year:</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-MECH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-P-DEPTH">**Depth.** Clarity is degraded in the [5](../SOURCES.md#F-6607da8501) days after an hour of critical-shear exceedance at that station, scaling with the depth attenuation term: large where the bed is at most [10](../SOURCES.md#F-2d96b35ff5) m deep, zero within noise where it is deeper than [20](../SOURCES.md#F-9275bc1448) m, **in the same storms**.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-P-DEPTH "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-P-SUB">**Substrate.** Present over GEUS *Mud and sandy mud* / *Muddy sand* / *Quaternary clay and silt*; absent over *Sand* / *Gravel and coarse sand* / *Till/diamicton* / *Sedimentary rock* (the layer is described in [`D1.md`](D1.md)).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-P-SUB "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-P-RELAX">**Relaxation.** The coefficient decays monotonically over the [10](../SOURCES.md#F-94cfdf8e28) days after an exceedance; a step persisting for weeks is a season, not a storm.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-P-RELAX "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-FALSIFY">**Falsified if** the within-station coefficient lies inside the null below; **or** the control deeper than [20](../SOURCES.md#F-9275bc1448) m moves as much as the arm at most [10](../SOURCES.md#F-2d96b35ff5) m deep; **or** the coarse-substrate coefficient equals the mud one; **or** the lag profile is flat. Together these predictions separate [D7](../hypodrafts/D7.md "Storm-driven resuspension") from "winter is murkier."</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-FALSIFY "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The data held, counted here

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SECCHI">**Response — Secchi depth.** `data/raw/oda/maaledybde.csv.gz` holds [151,203](../SOURCES.md#F-eea1e4eb92) records; [96,708](../SOURCES.md#F-e51550bdc9) carry a positive Secchi depth, a positive bottom depth and a year, [1980](../SOURCES.md#F-f944d2516c) to [2026](../SOURCES.md#F-ef805012bf). By bottom depth: [0](../SOURCES.md#F-ad68e454df)–[5](../SOURCES.md#F-7f0e8a949b) m [23,160](../SOURCES.md#F-6ce45ba3d4) · [5](../SOURCES.md#F-1c5d691c01)–[10](../SOURCES.md#F-5723eac741) m [20,392](../SOURCES.md#F-21dcc91cb3) · [10](../SOURCES.md#F-db815ba183)–[20](../SOURCES.md#F-4ed303263b) m [31,981](../SOURCES.md#F-c8d07c0744) · [20](../SOURCES.md#F-94a38e5aba)–[40](../SOURCES.md#F-9d63bd2b8f) m [17,454](../SOURCES.md#F-5f906c87db) · [40](../SOURCES.md#F-dc99d4a6e5)–[200](../SOURCES.md#F-0a91013e45) m [3,714](../SOURCES.md#F-f5de4748e9).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SECCHI "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-CENSOR">*Censored at the bed, and unequally between the arms.* Comparing the two depths each record carries, the share of readings in which the disc reached the bottom is [36.9](../SOURCES.md#F-46aa1895a2)% at [0](../SOURCES.md#F-ad68e454df)–[5](../SOURCES.md#F-7f0e8a949b) m and [10.0](../SOURCES.md#F-2ff095ec97)% at [5](../SOURCES.md#F-1c5d691c01)–[10](../SOURCES.md#F-5723eac741) m, against [0.2](../SOURCES.md#F-dbc1d51af8)% at [20](../SOURCES.md#F-94a38e5aba)–[40](../SOURCES.md#F-9d63bd2b8f) m and [0.0](../SOURCES.md#F-68bac1a7d0)% at [40](../SOURCES.md#F-dc99d4a6e5)–[200](../SOURCES.md#F-0a91013e45) m; the supplier's own flag `SigtTilBund` is set on [26,380](../SOURCES.md#F-d626dd3578) of all [151,203](../SOURCES.md#F-eea1e4eb92) records.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-CENSOR "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-TOBIT">The disc hits bottom exactly when the water is clear, so censoring correlates with the predictor *and* differs between the arms: an uncensored fit would manufacture the depth prediction from censoring alone. Model it interval-censored ("at least the bottom depth").</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-TOBIT "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SCOPE">`SigtDybdeMedVandkikkert` — read through a water telescope — is True on [6,104](../SOURCES.md#F-c0e04565fb) records, so the Secchi column holds readings taken two ways; a test models the flag or keeps one kind.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SCOPE "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-NOCLOCK">The extract has a date and no clock field.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-NOCLOCK "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-XUTM">In all [151,203](../SOURCES.md#F-eea1e4eb92) records the second easting column `X_UTM321` repeats `X_UTM32`, and there is no northing column, so a position comes from the station register.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-XUTM "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-TAIL">**Visits are not drawn at random over the weather.** Hence a test on the relaxation tail, not the storm hour: a design consequence, not a caveat.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-TAIL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-KD">**Second response.** `lys.csv.gz` holds [2,370,091](../SOURCES.md#F-d9b22c989d) records of light-attenuation profiles (`LyssvaekkelsesKoefficient`, K_d) at [566](../SOURCES.md#F-c9c0e8b759) stations with a position; this project's light analysis counts [62,741](../SOURCES.md#F-e98d356567) casts in them with a positive K_d and a date, and its growing-season casts run from [1980](../SOURCES.md#F-a8cef07c63) to [2026](../SOURCES.md#F-4e008ddd04).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-KD "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-KDPATH">Whether the profiles come from an instrument separate from the CTD cast is not established here; this project's list of independent production paths does not count them.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-KDPATH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-TURB">**Third response — turbidity is in the archive.** The CTD extract carries `Turbiditet` on [1,076,915](../SOURCES.md#F-85266abfd1) rows and `FDOM` on [890,921](../SOURCES.md#F-acb2b229c0) rows, the latter from [2021](../SOURCES.md#F-281b3dc6e4) to [2026](../SOURCES.md#F-70522e245c); neither reaches the monthly panel.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-TURB "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-TURBPATH">It is **not a separate production path**: it comes from the same CTD casts as the oxygen channel — another channel of the same path.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-TURBPATH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-PREDICTOR">**Predictor.** Bed shear is a model output, not an observation, and this repository has one: `scripts/waves.py` → `data/derived/waves.json`, hourly from 1995-01-01 to 2025-12-31 ([271,752](../SOURCES.md#F-ba6227fdb8) hours): ERA5 wind → the fetch in the wind's direction, read from a table (`data/raw/weather/fetch.json`) that no script in the repository produces → wave growth by Young and Verhagen (1996) → orbital velocity at the bed → Swart friction.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-PREDICTOR "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-UNCHECKED">It is computed for Køge Bugt only, at fixed depths of [3](../SOURCES.md#F-8b8eb9b44c), [5](../SOURCES.md#F-5174a7b0b3) and [10](../SOURCES.md#F-000ba6561e) m, and has **never been confronted with an observation** of sediment moving.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-UNCHECKED "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-MARINE">The Open-Meteo marine files under `data/raw/marine/` carry hourly wave height and sea-surface temperature beside the currents `currents.py` reads; those wave heights are a model output too, and nothing here sets them against transparency.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-MARINE "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-WIND">Wind is the end of the chain closer to observation, so τ is driven from wind, not from a wave field.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-WIND "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Sources beyond those held, and whether each is a separate path

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SRC-DMI">**DMI oceanObs** — the source register records DMI's open API as serving sea level observed at its stations, unauthenticated in testing. Wind setup in a shallow bay is *observed* storm forcing, independent of ERA5 and of any wave model: the anchor τ lacks. **A separate path.**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SRC-DMI "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SRC-WAV">**Copernicus Marine `BALTICSEA_MULTIYEAR_WAV_003_015`** — an hourly hindcast of significant wave height, period and direction from the wave model WAM with surface forcing from ECMWF's ERA5, over the Baltic including the Danish Belts, the Kattegat and Skagerrak.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SRC-WAV "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SRC-WAV-PATH">**Not a separate path**: the same atmosphere as the held wind; only the wave step differs.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SRC-WAV-PATH "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SRC-OC">**Copernicus Marine `OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_L3_MY_009_133`** — daily satellite observations of plankton, reflectance and transparency as the diffuse attenuation coefficient of light (`KD490`).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SRC-OC "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SRC-OC-PATH">**A separate path**: satellite radiometry, daily, so it can resolve a storm's tail where cloud allows.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SRC-OC-PATH "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-SRC-SS">**ODA water chemistry**, held (`kemi.csv.gz`): suspended solids (`Suspenderede stoffer`) on [19,314](../SOURCES.md#F-019429f805) rows and turbidity on [60](../SOURCES.md#F-91a8debc9d), from water samples. **A separate path** from the sonde.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-SRC-SS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-PROC">Compute fetch per station from the held OSM coastline (`data/raw/osm/coastline.json`) for the shallow stations and the deep controls; run `waves.py`'s chain per station at its own `BundDybde_m`, giving τ(station, hour). Per visit form E_ℓ = max τ in day ℓ before the visit, for ℓ up to [10](../SOURCES.md#F-94cfdf8e28). Fit an interval-censored (Tobit) Secchi model on E_ℓ — station, month-of-year, year absorbed — interacted with depth and substrate; repeat on K_d and on `Turbiditet`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-PROC "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The null, under the constraint actually imposed

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-NULLCONSTR">The constraint: visits sit where and when they sit, and storms are autocorrelated. A shuffle of τ across visits breaks both, and scores any seasonal cycle that storms and transparency share as signal.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-NULLCONSTR "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-NULL-TIME">**The time null.** Circular-shift the whole hourly τ series by whole years ± up to [60](../SOURCES.md#F-0ec6ff20ad) days, re-deriving the lags each draw. Preserves the seasonal cycle and storm autocorrelation exactly; destroys only the registration between *this* storm and *this* visit.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-NULL-TIME "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-NULL-DEPTH">**The depth null.** Keep τ and the visits intact; permute *bottom depth* among stations within substrate class and a [50](../SOURCES.md#F-1938ee28d0) km neighbourhood. Kills the depth prediction and preserves the rest, including any tendency of shallow stations to lie near the coast.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-NULL-DEPTH "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-D7-EFFN">**Effective n is events, not visits.** One weather system can cover the whole domain, so stations sampled in its wake observe the same storm. Report distinct exceedance events and stations per event — never the number of visits.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-D7-EFFN "What this claim rests on")</sup>
